blob_id: sha256(AP) of canonical descriptor followed by payload bytes
blob_template: blob/<AP content address>; ndarray native or uint8 canonical recursively typed JSON

choices_semantics.held_nav_sourceK: NAV and held source K concurrence; no reset-cause attribution
choices_semantics.nav_sourceK: NAV and delivered whiff source K concurrence; no reset-cause attribution

primitive_log: Each GS250 original generator call is transcribed directly against its own unchanged BitGenerator handle; no Passive transcript substitution after divergence. Literal reference transcript sharing only after registered disabled whole-trajectory identity. Same-state pre-wrapper proof uses candidate own actual inputs/state/primitive results.
primitive_log_boundary: Original outer source API invocation only; nested native dispatch delegates once, no extra transcript/draw. Instrumentation passivity is checked for disabled and enabled candidate in spent H0 with same-state and full candidate logger/plain identity.
raw_encoding: NPZ compressed; hex nibble a-p maps to 0-f
sample_rule: bool masks; indices int64; geometry/clocks float64; original outputs retain native dtype
state_event_rule: construction(-1); per tick pre -> base(original _act return, before N2) -> pre_wrapper(complete original act, before q/override) -> wrapper(after q/override, before move) -> bump(after original move/bump)
instance_policy_memory: GS250 and GSOff add only int64 q[R]. Enabled/off is immutable class configuration, not extra instance history. Original-state identity excludes only q; full candidate snapshots retain q.
reference_entry_semantics: Fly/Passive/Agent17 reading marker fields are external shadow eligibility; GS250 actual entry is rising engaged; GSOff records no actual engagement.

inference.shared: One saved index matrix for all matched conditions and all seven paired endpoints in that stage
inference.reduction: For each endpoint, convert bool to int64 before subtraction; mean(delta[indices],axis=1,dtype=float64); np.quantile(replicate_mean,[0.025,0.975],method=linear)
inference.independent_verifier: Saved indices/data only; no RNG or controller
inference.initial_final_state: Recursively typed, full PCG64 state; content addressed AP blobs
inference.mode: MAIN only; H0 has no inference role/generator/index matrix/paired bootstrap.

blob_grammar: blob/<AP content address>; ndarray native or uint8 canonical recursively typed JSON
identity_rule: Disabled original-field full equality; enabled same-state base_act and direct primitive proof, never enabled inter-arm whole-trajectory/input equality after divergence.
archive: Whole NPZ serialized as a-p nibbles; all native arrays exact dtype/shape including 0D; no pickle/object/quantization/NaN sentinels.

expanded_keysets.exact: No missing/extra non-blob key or changed dtype/shape; G rng checkpoint count is 1+8*T; E state/world events is 1+5*T
expanded_keysets.blob_keys: Only blob/<64 lowercase a-p content address>, exact declared closure of all references

H0.include: Exact expanded_keysets entries except every key starting inference/

q_mode: GSOff updates q by the delivered-whiff law, but immutable class configuration forces actual engaged/entry false; GS250 engaged=eligible. Other arms q_obs is external only.

first_entry_semantics_by_arm.GS250: first actual rising engaged; repeated entries diagnostic
first_entry_semantics_by_arm.GSOff: -1 actual first entry and zero actual entry event count

anchor_semantics.GS250: Actual first rising engaged m; anchor_valid iff m>=0. PRE pose is actual before sensing/move. All sample-derived anchor fields gather their native sample timing at m, except TGT/ TURN explicitly gather GS BASE_TGT/BASE_TURN at m. Original state values for pre_wrapper are separately retained in full state snapshots. q_obs from q_post; GS phase from wrapper at same m. Post-move POS/HEAD/ROT/C/AT2 remain entry-move baseline.
anchor_semantics.GSOff: No actual anchor: anchor_valid false for every row; integer index/clock anchors -1, bool anchors false, float anchors0; marker_step may exist only as separate external observation.
anchor_semantics.Fly_Passive_Agent17: R0 shadow marker anchors only, explicitly labeled observational; never called actual intervention.

inactive_rule: All inactive GS sentinels are keyed on engaged, not eligible. GSOff may be eligible but never engaged. No NaN sentinels.

metadata_rules.success: Exact keysets above; date/stage/mode are fixed; provenance runtime uses frozen complete stamp. records map has exactly all condition/arm pairs from efficacy and validity namespaces.
metadata_rules.failure: metrics: complete=false with its exact top-level keyset (no passed key); identity/verification: complete=false and passed=false with their own exact top-level keysets. first_failure populated. Unfinished maps/null raw or inference allowed only failure, never success aggregation.
metadata_rules.H0: stage H0, claim null, inference null, metrics clauses empty/verdict VALIDITY_ONLY. Stable H0 base implementation closure and its base-pin hash exclude every H0 result/receipt hash. Main execution pins subsequently add the completed matching H0 receipt hashes; no H0/pin self-cycle.
metadata_rules.direct_logs: GS250 and Passive draw_log_reference null and own original-handle primitive log. Other arms may refer to Passive only after disabled full identity is proven. base_act_proof must reference own-state/own-input proof; no active inter-arm substitution.
metadata_rules.primitive_payloads: Numeric seed args, huge PCG64 integers and raw payloads stored as typed AP blob references, not plaintext numeric seed copies in notes/reports.
metadata_rules.claim_success_failure: Exclusive pair claim immutable header; result initially null, then AP result receipt with status; consumed claim never removed. A phase fault writes emergency receipt and closes stage INVALID.
metadata_rules.extensions: No undeclared extra key/dtype/tag/fieldset. Any implementation bookkeeping addition requires reviewed amendment before any reserved generator; does not authorize criterion/state changes.
metadata_rules.base_proofs: Same_state proof uses own actual pre-state/input/primitive refs, complete expected original pre_wrapper state and base return, zero-tolerance comparisons. Plain_logger_H0 is null in MAIN; for enabled H0 it is a full plain GS250 versus logger proof stored only as declared content-addressed typed blob maps/timelines (same fixed native array shapes and GS fieldset), not an undeclared sixth non-blob array arm. Never evaluate candidate efficacy on this proof. Non-GS lineage arms carry method not_applicable_lineage and null same-state maps, with separate full lineage gates.

typed_tag_rules: R0 Archive.tag exact grammar: Python float.value is float.hex string; NumPy scalar retains dtype/byte AP; sets sorted by canonical(tag), dict stores ordered [tag(key),tag(value)] pairs; list/tuple ordered; arrays native exact dtype and 0D; missing_hash sha256(AP) of byte M. Descriptor kind ndarray has kind/dtype/shape; typed_json has kind only. Canonical JSON sort_keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii true, allow_nan false.

anchor_field_mapping.TGT: gs/BASE_TGT[m] for GS250/GSOff; sample/TGT[m] for other arms
anchor_field_mapping.TURN: gs/BASE_TURN[m] for GS250/GSOff; sample/TURN[m] for other arms
anchor_field_mapping.HEAD: sample/HEAD[m]
anchor_field_mapping.q_obs: gs/q_post[m] for GS250; reading/q_obs[m] for shadow arms

anchor_phase_rule: PRE_POS/PRE_HEAD/PRE_ROT before sensing/act/move; original clocks/core/EST from their exact sample pre/base/post-act timing; BASE target/turn from pre_wrapper; q/GS phase after q update in wrapper; POS/HEAD/ROT/C/AT2 after original move/bump entry-step baseline. actual executed command is sample/TGT, sample/TURN and gs/SEARCH_* for active GS, never substituted for BASE anchor.
